note: Dated, sourced events that change the premise of inventory topics. Read by core/profitdecoded/freshness.js. Topic titles are NEVER rewritten from this file: a flagged topic keeps its title and must be researched again. Kinds: CHANGED_CONTEXT (premise may still hold but the facts around it moved), OUTDATED_PREMISE (the title states something that is no longer true), PREMISE_CONTRADICTED (a primary source contradicts the title's claim). Sources are what the reviewer read; the research agent must still confirm them against primary documents.

entries.event: The US Mint struck the final circulating penny on 2025-11-12 and ended circulating penny production; Treasury put the unit cost at 3.69 cents (FY2024). Pennies remain legal tender; collector versions continue.

topics.impact: the title says the US still makes the penny; circulating production ended in 2025
the cost story now has an ending (production stopped); rounding and the remaining coins are the live questions

entries.event: Spirit Airlines announced on 2026-05-02 that it ceased all operations, after Chapter 11 filings in November 2024 and August 2025.

topics.impact: present-tense title about an airline that no longer operates; the story is now a failure story

entries.event: Southwest Airlines began charging for checked bags on bookings made on or after 2025-05-28 ($35 first bag, $45 second).

topics.impact: the change happened; research must use post-change fees and results, not the pre-2025 debate

entries.event: The US de minimis duty exemption for packages from China and Hong Kong ended in May 2025; Temu moved to US-warehouse listings and added import charges, Shein raised prices.

topics.impact: the duty-free parcel model behind the low prices was cut off; 'can sell so cheaply' must be re-checked
growth story must include the 2025 model change
US pricing and shipping changed in 2025

entries.event: The Eighth Circuit vacated the FTC's amended Negative Option ('click-to-cancel') Rule on 2025-07-08, days before compliance. Cancellation practices remain policed case by case and by state laws.

topics.impact: no federal click-to-cancel rule in force; check current state rules and FTC cases
same regulatory change
same regulatory change; check the status of any Adobe-specific case before scripting
same regulatory change

entries.event: Amazon agreed on 2025-09-25 to pay $2.5 billion ($1B civil penalty, $1.5B refunds) to settle the FTC's Prime enrollment/cancellation case, with a 10-year order requiring a clear decline option and same-method cancellation.

topics.impact: the story now has a resolution (settlement terms); script must use them

entries.event: The FTC Rule on Unfair or Deceptive Fees (16 CFR Part 464) took effect 2025-05-12 for live-event tickets and short-term lodging: the total price including mandatory fees (e.g. resort fees) must be shown up front. The fees themselves are not banned.

topics.impact: covered lodging must now show the total price including resort fees from the start
covered live-event tickets must now show the all-in price up front
a federal fee-disclosure rule now covers tickets and lodging

entries.event: Congress repealed the CFPB's December 2024 overdraft rule (which would have capped fees at large institutions at $5 or cost) under the Congressional Review Act; signed 2025-05-09 (P.L. 119-10).

topics.impact: the proposed federal cap is gone; current fee revenue and bank policy changes must be re-researched
same regulatory change

entries.event: The 2025 federal tax law (One Big Beautiful Bill Act, July 2025) created an income-tax deduction for qualified tips of up to $25,000 per year for 2025-2028 (payroll taxes still apply).

sources.tier: secondary (tax firm); confirm against IRS guidance

topics.impact: tipping economics now include a federal tax incentive for qualified tips
same tax change

entries.event: FDA's over-the-counter hearing aid category took effect 2022-10-17 for adults with perceived mild-to-moderate hearing loss (no exam or prescription required).

topics.impact: a cheaper OTC category exists; 'cost so much' must be scoped to prescription devices and current prices

entries.event: AMC's FY2024 10-K reports film exhibition costs of 48.4% of admissions revenue company-wide (51.6% in US markets): the chain keeps roughly half of ticket revenue before its operating costs.

topics.impact: 'almost nothing from ticket sales' conflicts with the largest US chain keeping about half of admissions revenue; the claim needs a narrower, sourced framing
